'''Torg''' was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] soldier and member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] elite [[Havoc Squad]] unit. He followed his commander [[Aric Jorgan]] after he decided to leave [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] service and went on [[Zakuul]] to fight the [[Eternal Empire]].
